stem: Find the common domain of the function $n_3(x)=\frac{x}{x^3-4x}$. Tap the values that must be removed from R.

hints.text: Factorise the denominator completely: take out a common factor first, then factorise what is left.
Only zeroes of the denominator are removed; the numerator does not matter.
For each factor set it equal to zero and solve; check the signs.
